chatbot.title: Library System Assistant
chatbot.welcome: Hello! I'm your Library Management System assistant. I can help you with managing books, members, and borrowings. What would you like to know?
chatbot.greeting: Hello! I'm here to help you with the Library Management System. How can I assist you?
chatbot.help:
I can help you with:
• Adding, editing, and deleting books
• Managing library members
• Borrowing and returning books
• Searching the catalog
• Understanding system features
• Dashboard statistics

What would you like to know about the system?
chatbot.dashboard: The Dashboard shows key statistics: total books, members, borrowed books, overdue books, available copies, and categories. Access it from the main navigation or use the floating action button.
chatbot.addBook: To add a book: Go to Books section → Click 'Add New Book' button → Fill in details (title, author, ISBN, category, etc.) → Click 'Add'. The book will be saved to the system.
chatbot.editBook: To edit a book: Go to Books section → Find the book → Click the edit icon (✏️) → Modify the details → Click 'Update'. Changes are saved immediately.
chatbot.deleteBook: To delete a book: Go to Books section → Find the book → Click the delete icon (🗑️) → Confirm deletion. Note: Books with active borrowings cannot be deleted.
chatbot.search: To search books: Use the search bar in the Books section. You can search by title, author, ISBN, or category. The results update in real-time as you type.
chatbot.addMember: To add a member: Go to Members section → Click 'Add New Member' button → Fill in personal details (name, email, phone, address, membership type) → Click 'Add'. The member will be registered in the system.
chatbot.memberStatus:
Members can have three statuses:
• Active: Can borrow books
• Inactive: Account disabled
• Suspended: Temporarily restricted

Change status by editing the member.
chatbot.borrowProcess:
To borrow a book:
1. Go to Borrowings section
2. Click 'Borrow Book'
3. Select a book from the dropdown
4. Select a member
5. Click 'Borrow'

Books are loaned for 14 days. Available copies decrease automatically.
chatbot.returnProcess:
To return a book:
1. Go to Borrowings section
2. Find the borrowing record
3. Click 'Return Book' button
4. Confirm the return

If overdue, fines are calculated automatically (0.50 per day).
chatbot.overdue: Overdue books are highlighted in red. Fines are calculated at $0.50 per day after the due date. Return overdue books as soon as possible to avoid accumulating fines.
chatbot.categories: Books are organized by categories (Fiction, Non-Fiction, Science, etc.). You can filter and search by category. Categories help organize the library collection.
chatbot.available: Available copies show how many books can be borrowed. When a book is borrowed, available copies decrease. When returned, they increase. Books with 0 available copies cannot be borrowed.
chatbot.isbn: ISBN (International Standard Book Number) is a unique identifier for each book. You can search books by ISBN in the search bar. Each book should have a unique ISBN.
